prompt: Generate a vertical 9:16 photograph taken on a cheap disposable camera with harsh on-camera flash, late at night inside a small British kebab shop. Two mates in their thirties stand face to face beside a plastic table piled with chips in polystyrene trays. The stocky one in a grey hoodie hums with his eyes shut and one finger raised like a conductor; the lanky one in a faded football shirt leans in, mouth open mid-note, hands carving a different rhythm in the air. Both grin with total certainty. Blown-out flash on their faces, dark falloff behind, greasy chrome counter, blurred rotating spit, plain unmarked walls. Slightly tilted, off-centre framing, red-eye glints, grainy 1990s colour print. Thanks.
